source: Internet Archive djen-tjro-2025 OCR cadernos (public DJEN publications) for the original 20-doc seed; TJRO JURIS system (src/tjro_juris, real digitally-native court text, not OCR) for the 20-doc expansion batch
per_class_note: Counts above are train-split only, matching the original convention. preliminar_inicio/fim are 0 across ALL splits (not just train) as of the 20-doc JURIS expansion batch -- none of the 20 sampled JURIS documents happened to contain a preliminar section (sampling variance, not a labeling gap); a targeted follow-up batch is needed to close this specific category.
labeler: prompt_subagents:haiku (original 20-doc seed, one labeling subagent per batch, acordaos first); prompt_subagents:general-purpose, one per document, for the 20-doc JURIS expansion batch
verification_note: IMPORTANT provenance distinction: the original 20-doc seed's val+test went through a decorrelated 4-role Sonnet ensemble verification pass before being trusted as eval-quality gold. The 20-doc JURIS expansion batch (tjro_juris_acordao_00..09, tjro_juris_sentenca_00..09) has NOT gone through that ensemble verification -- it has single-subagent labeling (one general-purpose agent per document, each independently briefed with the full annotation guideline), mechanical validation (opf_annotate.py validate: 0 offset/overlap/label-space errors across all 231 spans), and a manual spot-check of a sample of records by the orchestrating session (not exhaustive, not the full ensemble). Treat val/test docs from this batch as provisional-quality until they receive the same ensemble verification pass the original seed used, especially before reporting any eval metric that includes them.
notes: Seed gold built the subagent way: strict sampling (acordao requires ACORDAO+VOTO+ACORDAM, sentenca requires SENTENCA+dispositivo-formula+operative-verb; despachos excluded), Haiku labeling subagents returning {category,match,nth}, offsets resolved by opf_annotate from-spans, overlaps removed deterministically, then a decorrelated 4-role Sonnet ensemble over val+test. ref_normativa was originally excluded (regex pre-pass at inference) but was added back to the trained label space and bootstrapped into every split via the same regex pre-pass (scripts/ref_normativa_prepass.py) against the already-verified gold text -- see git history for the architecture decision and the regex fix (thousands-separator article numbers, spelled-out inciso/paragrafo/alinea) that preceded it. A second real bug was found and fixed in scripts/ref_normativa_prepass.py's merge_with_opf_spans: it only reliably favored a gold/model span over an overlapping regex span on an exact start-position tie, not on the more common case of a regex match starting earlier but still partially overlapping -- a real gold custas_fim span was being silently dropped by this before the fix. 20-doc JURIS expansion batch added 2026-07-16 (see verification_note above for its provenance/verification status) via the same subagent-labeling + opf_annotate.py from-spans/validate pipeline as the original seed, sourced from src/tjro_juris (TJRO JURIS system) rather than DJEN cadernos. Single-tribunal (TJRO) corpus of 40 docs; still needs preliminar-targeted documents, multi-tribunal sourcing (G4 gate), and substantially more volume (G5 gate needs >=150 total docs) before it clears the project's own readiness gates for a real (non --smoke) training run.
